description: Run whenever a Solana transaction or dry run fails, before retrying. Retrying blind burns fees. Turns a Solana error (hex code, log line or RPC error) into the plain cause and fix. Offline, no chain call. Example: {"error": "custom program error: 0x1771", "program": "JUP6LkbZbjS1jKKwapdHNy74zcZ3tLUZoi5QNyVTaV4"}. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/why_failed.

error.description: The error as you got it: "custom program error: 0x1771", "InsufficientFundsForRent", or the RPC error object. From your send or RPC error, a dry-run result, a wallet message, or history.

program.description: The failing program. Needed to read custom error codes right. From the log line "Program <address> failed", or from explain_tx.

name: why_failed
